name: Konflux Open-Source CI/CD
free_limit: Apache-2.0-licensed Kubernetes-native CI/CD software for building, testing, signing and releasing artifacts; no Konflux software license fee or vendor-imposed build quota when self-hosted.
watch_out: You operate the Kubernetes cluster, Tekton pipelines, registries and storage; infrastructure, CI workers, networking and artifact hosting can cost money. This is not a free vendor-hosted Konflux account. Commercial use follows Apache-2.0 notice and license obligations.
